COLDWAR_NKO_christian_republic.description: Consolidate a civic order without granting any faith ownership of the state.

COLDWAR_NKO_foreign_missions.name: A Wider Foreign Service
COLDWAR_NKO_foreign_missions.description: A professional foreign service can pursue trade and technical exchange while defending the republic’s freedom of action.

COLDWAR_NKO_gdr_machinery.name: East German Machinery
COLDWAR_NKO_gdr_machinery.description: Pyongyang proposes East German machinery and specialist training in exchange for reliable industrial deliveries.

COLDWAR_NKO_bulgarian_engineering.name: Bulgarian Engineering
COLDWAR_NKO_bulgarian_engineering.description: Pyongyang proposes joint work on milling, communications and agricultural engineering, with deliveries linked to agreed project schedules.

COLDWAR_NKO_romanian_exchange.name: Romanian Exchange
COLDWAR_NKO_romanian_exchange.description: Pyongyang proposes a modest programme of industrial and agricultural exchange to diversify its socialist trading partners.

COLDWAR_NKO_gdr_training.name: Machine-Tool Standards
COLDWAR_NKO_gdr_training.description: Agree machine-tool standards and specialist placements to make imported East German plant easier to operate and maintain.

COLDWAR_NKO_bulgarian_agrobiology.name: Agricultural Science
COLDWAR_NKO_bulgarian_agrobiology.description: Arrange field trials and exchanges with Bulgarian agronomists to improve the use of fertilizer, seed and agricultural machinery.

COLDWAR_NKO_romanian_trade.name: Reciprocal Trade
COLDWAR_NKO_romanian_trade.description: Agree reciprocal industrial and agricultural delivery schedules that both trading partners can sustain.

COLDWAR_NKO_technical_exchange.name: Technical Exchange
COLDWAR_NKO_technical_exchange.description: Put foreign technical placements and agreed standards to work in domestic production.

COLDWAR_NKO_egyptian_technical.name: The Egyptian Accord
COLDWAR_NKO_egyptian_technical.description: Pyongyang proposes scientific exchange, technical placements and maintenance training under the bilateral cooperation framework.

COLDWAR_NKO_japan_fisheries.name: Fisheries Negotiations
COLDWAR_NKO_japan_fisheries.description: Pyongyang proposes government authorization for a limited fisheries and commercial arrangement without diplomatic recognition.

COLDWAR_NKO_egyptian_missions.name: Technical Missions
COLDWAR_NKO_egyptian_missions.description: Exchange technical missions and maintenance specialists to improve equipment support and practical training.

COLDWAR_NKO_japan_ports.name: Commercial Port Access
COLDWAR_NKO_japan_ports.description: Negotiate limited port access and commercial services for authorized fisheries and trade without diplomatic recognition.

COLDWAR_NKO_war_line.name: The Liberation Line
COLDWAR_NKO_war_line.description: Reunification by force will demand a costly concentration of military power and the abandonment of a negotiated settlement.

COLDWAR_NKO_forward_batteries.name: Forward Artillery
COLDWAR_NKO_forward_batteries.description: Forward batteries can strike southern defensive positions, but their deployment and ammunition stocks will be difficult to conceal.

COLDWAR_NKO_forward_supply.name: Forward Supply Depots
COLDWAR_NKO_forward_supply.description: Concentrate transport and stores behind the armistice line to sustain an offensive beyond its opening phase.

COLDWAR_NKO_war_mobilization.name: General Mobilization
COLDWAR_NKO_war_mobilization.description: Mobilize reserves and place industry on a war footing, drawing skilled workers away from civilian production.

COLDWAR_NKO_campaign_command.name: A Southern Command
COLDWAR_NKO_campaign_command.description: Establish the command arrangements needed to coordinate a sustained campaign south of the armistice line.

COLDWAR_NKO_armed_reunification.name: Reunification by Force
COLDWAR_NKO_armed_reunification.description: The leadership has resolved to pursue reunification through a renewed campaign against the South.

COLDWAR_NKO_jongil_authority.name: Succession Authority
COLDWAR_NKO_jongil_authority.description: Kim Jong Il must turn the authority accumulated under his father into an enduring command over party and state.

COLDWAR_NKO_jongil_cadres.name: The Party Centre
COLDWAR_NKO_jongil_cadres.description: Rely on the established party apparatus to preserve discipline and continuity through the transition.

COLDWAR_NKO_jongil_cabinet.name: A Cabinet Mandate
COLDWAR_NKO_jongil_cabinet.description: Give the cabinet greater authority to manage production and external procurement under the new leadership.

COLDWAR_NKO_jongil_settlement.name: The New Leadership
COLDWAR_NKO_jongil_settlement.description: Consolidate the leadership settlement chosen for the Republic after the founding generation.
